## 验证 / Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`

涉及界面请附脱敏截图；涉及协议请附官方依据并说明真实账号测试范围。
For UI changes, attach redacted screenshots. For protocol changes, include official references and the scope of live-account testing.

## 影响与限制 / Impact and limitations

说明数据迁移、配置兼容或已知限制。Note any data migration, configuration compatibility or known limitations.
